summary: A 1 dp horizontal rule across its parent, optionally inset from the start to line up with list text.

inset.doc: Start inset in dp, e.g. 72 under ListItems with a 40 dp Avatar (16 + 40 + 16). 0: a single box

pitfalls: The inset is padding on an outer box around a filled inner box: padding before a background on the same box insets the background in Java and the TypeScript player but not in the C++ player, so the two-box form is the one that looks the same everywhere
